trust_decision.summary: Whether a request URI is subject to a security constraint, and which constraint set is selected: RealmBase.findSecurityConstraints picks the most specific (longest) matching path-prefix constraint from context.findConstraints(), and a null result means 'unconstrained' so the request passes the authenticator.

landing_point.why: The summary says the security constraint with the longest matching path must be selected, which points straight at findSecurityConstraints and its longest/length selection loop (lines 611-669); the published change is a single condition on line 639.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP request through any AuthenticatorBase valve (AuthenticatorBase.java:524) and the public Realm API org.apache.catalina.Realm#findSecurityConstraints (Realm.java:152)
fix_sites.module_kind: core request processing, access-control implementation (catalina realm), not a web-app-facing API

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report and changelog speak only about overlapping path patterns inside a collection, so a solver can argue that collections restricted to some HTTP methods are a different feature, already addressed by the opt-in deny-uncovered-http-methods element that is off by default (java/org/apache/tomcat/util/descriptor/web/WebXml.java:500).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A more specific allow constraint must override a broader deny: /level1/level2/ has to stay accessible while /level1/ and /level1/level2/level3/ are denied; a fix that keeps or unions all matching constraints instead of selecting the longest one turns the legitimate allow into a deny.

O6_input_shapes: one SecurityCollection carrying several overlapping path-prefix patterns, with a shorter matching pattern after the longer one in the array
several constraints whose collections match the same URI at different prefix lengths (/level1/*, /level1/level2/*, /level1/level2/level3/*)
URI equal to the pattern without its trailing slash (pattern.length()-2 == uri.length() branch)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A longer matching path-prefix collection that is restricted to other HTTP methods clears the result set and sets found=false, so the broader matching constraint is dropped and the request is treated as unconstrained instead of falling back to the shorter constraint.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Method coverage is the job of the separate deny-uncovered-http-methods feature; the report is about which pattern wins, not about method lists.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same method, 13 lines below the fixed condition

O8_uncovered_routes.route: An exact url-pattern match sets found=true before the method check, so a GET-only exact constraint for /app/secret returns null for a POST and the broader /app/* deny constraint is never evaluated.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Exact match has higher precedence by design, and a method the winning pattern does not list is what deny-uncovered-http-methods is for.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same method, 31 lines above the fixed condition

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second URL-pattern matcher (included/matchPattern, with different semantics from RealmBase's inline matcher) used today only by trace logging.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer consolidating 'which constraint applies' into the public included(uri, method) helper would reproduce the same selection problem in another package, and the existing duplicate matcher makes that edit look natural.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A longest-extension selection stage for *.ext patterns, symmetric with the fixed path-prefix stage.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The precedence stages in findSecurityConstraints are written as parallel loops, so a maintainer applying the longest-match rule per stage would add one here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Normalise/deduplicate/sort the patterns of a constraint in addConstraint before they reach the selector.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: addConstraint already rewrites patterns through adjustURLPattern (line 2855), so sorting patterns by length there is a plausible competing 'fix' location that misses constraints added by other routes.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Longest-match logic inside findUncoveredHttpMethods, the startup producer that synthesises deny constraints for uncovered methods.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already re-derives pattern/method coverage independently of RealmBase, so a maintainer could decide the overlapping-pattern rule belongs there.

O9_family: improper access control (CWE-284): the most specific security constraint is not selected, so a broader deny constraint is dropped

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Keep every matching constraint (or compare each pattern against longest directly) so no deny is ever dropped, which also denies the legitimately allowed sub-path.
